about.journeyText: We spent over a year perfecting our formula — balancing green tea caffeine with L-theanine, combining plant protein with fiber, and eliminating every ingredient we didn't believe in. The result is CAFO: one flavour, perfected.

howItWorks.title: HOW IT WORKS
howItWorks.subtitle: The science behind sustained focus
howItWorks.caffeineText: Unlike synthetic caffeine in energy drinks, our 90mg comes from green tea extract. It's absorbed more gradually, providing a smooth energy curve instead of a spike-and-crash.
howItWorks.ltheanineText: L-theanine works with caffeine to promote focused alertness without anxiety. This combination has been studied extensively — it enhances attention and reduces the negative side effects of caffeine alone.
howItWorks.proteinText: 14g of plant protein and 5g of fiber slow digestion, creating a steady release of energy. No blood sugar spikes, no crashes — just hours of sustained focus.
howItWorks.lowGiText: Our formula is designed with a low glycemic index, meaning it won't spike your blood sugar. This keeps your energy stable and your mind sharp.

faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about CAFO Energy
faq.ctaText: We're happy to help. Reach out and we'll get back to you.
faq.q1: How much caffeine is in a CAFO bar?
faq.a1: Each bar contains 90mg of natural caffeine from green tea extract — roughly the same as a cup of coffee, but smoother. Green tea caffeine is paired with L-theanine, which takes the edge off and gives you calm, focused energy rather than a sharp spike. No jitters. No crash.
faq.q2: Can I eat more than one bar a day?
faq.a2: Yes — that's kind of the point. At 90mg per bar, you can have three across the day and land at 270mg total, which is well within the FDA's recommended limit of 400mg. Morning, midday, pre-workout: each bar fits cleanly into your routine without pushing you over.
faq.q3: How long does the energy last?
faq.a3: Most people feel the effect within 20–30 minutes and sustain it for 3–5 hours. Because the caffeine comes from green tea and is paired with protein and fibre, absorption is steadier than coffee or energy drinks — so the energy tapers off gradually instead of cutting out suddenly.
faq.q4: When's the best time to eat a CAFO bar?
faq.a4: 15–30 minutes before you need to be on. That means before a study session, before training, during a long drive, or as an afternoon pick-me-up. One rule: try not to eat it after 3pm if you're sensitive to caffeine — the half-life means it'll still be partly active at bedtime.
faq.q5: How does it compare to energy drinks?
faq.a5: Energy drinks give you caffeine plus a lot of things you don't need — sugar, artificial sweeteners, synthetic stimulants, colours. A CAFO bar gives you 90mg natural caffeine, 14g protein, and 5g fibre. It's food that works, not a drink engineered to taste like a science experiment.
faq.q6: When will I receive my order?
faq.a6: We're currently in pre-launch and taking waitlist signups. Once we ship, orders within Sweden will arrive within 2–4 business days. European shipping will follow shortly after launch — sign up to be the first to know when your country goes live.
